notes: Chicago Data Portal, 'Bike Routes (Deprecated February 2020)' dataset (auur-f9g5), sum of per-segment shape_leng field (1,693,175.47 feet / 5280 = 320.75 miles) across 726 segments. Cross-checked for plausibility against the Jan2021 and Nov2021 snapshots and CDOT's own stated ~30 miles/year growth rate since 2020 -- the progression is consistent.

Chicago Data Portal, 'Bike Routes (Deprecated November 2021)' dataset (8ec2-eaj2), sum of the mi_ctrline field directly (already in miles). A 'Bike Routes (Deprecated January 2021)' snapshot (ard8-rcb7) also exists for this year (326.32mi via shape_leng/5280) -- the later November snapshot was used as more representative of full-year 2021.

Chicago Data Portal, 'Bike Routes (Deprecated December 2022)' dataset (9saw-v2cz), sum of the mi_ctrline field directly. Note: this is LOWER than the 2021 figure (359.18mi) -- a real discrepancy in the source data, not smoothed or corrected here. Likely reflects a change in which bikeway categories/geometries were included between dataset vintages (CDOT's deprecated snapshots are not guaranteed to use identical schemas), rather than bike lanes actually being removed. Reported as-is from the official dataset.
